title: ADK Karting Experience
specs: Indoor electric go-kart racing with high-performance karts
Family-friendly sessions with reduced speed on adult track
Junior Riders: 5+ years old & minimum 48” tall
Family Friendly: Ages 10–14 and minimum 56” tall
Teen/Adult Riders: 15+ years old & minimum 56” tall
